title: ARCADE: THE WORLD STAYS LIGHT
why: His yes to the five recommendations for the Halloween party mode, arcade29, found by the 3-hour arcade soak. Over 3 hours of nonstop play the enemies on the map grew from 41 to 217 and the containers from 154 to 598, because the waves land near the players and the old ones stay where they were left, and every kill leaves a body or a wreck. Now, in the arcade only, the run owner takes off a wave enemy that has been far from every player for a minute while not chasing, and a searched or empty body, wreck or dropped pile that is far from everyone and over five minutes old. Player 2 sees them go too. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade, far idle wave enemies and old searched bodies and wrecks are cleared away, so a long party night stays smooth.
